{{Attr|Freeze}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Black Death}}''' - The '''Nuclear Guardian''' slashes the nearest tower with its scythe and stuns them for a few seconds. |music-1 = [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Red Hex Temple (Event Lobby Theme)|250px|center|thumb]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Nuclear Guardian''' is a large guardian [[Enemies|enemy]] that appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It has a very high amount of health but a slightly slow speed. It has one ability, where it slashes a nearby tower with its scythe, stunning them. The '''Nuclear Guardian''' replaces the [[Fallen Guardian]] in [[Oops! All slimes!]] [[Challenge Maps|Challenge Map]]. ==Appearance== The '''Nuclear Guardian''' is a very large humanoid with a waist and lower arms in its rig. It has a desaturated dark green skin color and a black torso, waist and legs. It wears a black hood with grey feathers beside it, and has a grey metal bird beak along with two glowing green eyes. It wears grey shoulder-pads with glowing green insides, armbands with glowing green diamonds on the center of all of its sides and a chestplate with a green glowing diamond in the middle, with wiring connecting it to two cross shaped buttons. It wields a grey scythe that glows green which it uses to attack towers. The '''Nuclear Guardian''' has a death animation, where it will convulse while emitting sparks and small explosions, before all of its green lights turn dark grey with it subsequently falling backwards. It also plays a bird cawing sound on death. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |5% |8,750 |- !Wave !Health |} ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Engineer]], [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Accelerator]] are needed to use against this, due to its high health. **You should also use the [[Commander]] to boost these towers' firerate, making them deal more damage to it. *The [[Medic]] is highly recommended so that you can protect towers from stuns caused by the '''Nuclear Guardian''' from your towers, as it stuns quite frequently. *You can use defense dropping towers, such as the [[Golden Pyromancer]], [[Pyromancer]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] to decrease the '''Nuclear Guardian's''' defense, allowing your towers to deal more damage to it. **As freezing towers drop defense when an enemy is frozen or slowed down, they cannot be used as the '''Nuclear Guardian''' has the [[Freeze Immunity]]. *Freezing towers cannot freeze or slow down the '''Nuclear Guardian''' due to its [[Freeze Immunity]]. **The [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] can also only slow it down instead of stunning it while knockback towers like the [[Brawler]] cannot knock it back, as it has the [[Stun Immunity]]. ***Because of its size, the [[Warden]] will only slow it down for a shorter amount of time. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:NuclearGuardianDeath.ogg]] |When the '''Nuclear Guardian''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNuclearGuardian.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- ☢️ NUCLEAR Update!☢️|'''Nuclear Guardian''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexNuclearGuardian.png|'''Nuclear Guardian''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The scythe wielded by the '''Nuclear Guardian''' is a re-textured version of the [[Molten Boss]]' scythe. *The '''Nuclear Guardian's''' design is based on the [[Nuclear Fallen King]]'s design. *The mask worn by the '''Nuclear Guardian''' may be a reference to a [[wp:Plague doctor|plague doctor]]. **However, unlike a plague doctor, the beak on the mask worn by the '''Nuclear Guardian''' can open and close. ==Update History== *'''29 July 2022''' - [[v1.3.0]] **'''Nuclear Guardian''' added. *'''23 May 2023''' - [[v1.7.3]]a **[[Energy Immunity]] replaced with [[Stun Immunity]]. *'''19 July 2024''' - [[v1.26.0]] **Health decreased from 80,000 to 14,000 in [[Oops! All slimes!]]. *'''19 February 2025''' - [[v1.54.0]] **Modern version added. ***None of the changes are applied to the legacy version. **Health increased from 80,000 to 125,000. **Speed slightly increased from 2 to 2.4. **Defense decreased from 50% to 20%. **Now gives {{Money|125,000}} every 50% health lost. **{{Bug}} Appears twice in the [[Index]], one of them not loading in any model for the preview. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Health increased from 125,000 to 175,000. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer appears twice in the [[Index]]. ==Notes== {{PollutedWasteland|[[Cursed Skeleton]] & [[Necromancer King]]|Wave 23|Nuclear Guardian|Wave 24|[[Nuclear Monster]]|Wave 25}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Late-Game]]
